title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed the US session at 65,785 dollars, down 0.9 percent as Fear & Greed sank to 31. Price held a narrow range with no clear breakout. Hashrate remains firm at 731 exahashes, showing miner resilience. Mempool sits heavy at 87,237 transactions yet fees stay at 1 sat per vbyte, pointing to limited urgency.

Key takeaway: buyers are defending 65k support but conviction is thin. Overnight focus shifts to any volume surge or Asia-driven moves. Watch 66k resistance and 65k floor; a break eith
